decisions.reason: Generic tool recommendations, without concrete autonomous-experiment evidence useful to this series. The opening distinguishes the October 12, 2026 update from original publication on October 17, 2024; the recent update must not be presented as a newly published experiment ([saved opening](data/assets/419feb0137451bb2ed3c150d/c62c33737f81b7859987d32de9f2f19bafa2a36bf2482b8def3c4d4ba34306f6/text.txt#:~:text=LATEST%20UPDATE)). The 'Research' and 'Agents & productivity' sections offer personal preferences and product claims, without experimental protocols, held-out results, reproducible artifacts or measured research costs; their linked evaluations are not supplied evidence ([saved recommendations](data/assets/419feb0137451bb2ed3c150d/c62c33737f81b7859987d32de9f2f19bafa2a36bf2482b8def3c4d4ba34306f6/text.txt#:~:text=5.%20Research)). The closing paid-subscription appeal establishes a commercial newsletter interest, but does not establish vendor sponsorship ([saved appeal](data/assets/419feb0137451bb2ed3c150d/c62c33737f81b7859987d32de9f2f19bafa2a36bf2482b8def3c4d4ba34306f6/text.txt#:~:text=If%20you%20enjoy%20my%20stuff)). Recent product substitutions do not overcome the lack of relevant experimental evidence.

The supplied October 4 publication date is within the run's 30-day UTC window ending October 13, but this is a generic secondary news roundup. Its cloud-agent and model-price summaries do not document an autonomous research experiment ([saved release summaries](data/assets/4eab969d8f8f58425aecc153/7e321e65424e9a2edb24b698e1bca81a81aaeadd44ba001dab6237202ddb0ada/text.txt#:~:text=OpenAI%20news)). The potentially relevant Fig Labs evaluation and the Stratego result are only pointers: their original methods, compute accounting, baselines and full results are absent from the supplied evidence. They cannot substantiate an evaluation or affordability claim here ([saved resource and research pointers](data/assets/4eab969d8f8f58425aecc153/7e321e65424e9a2edb24b698e1bca81a81aaeadd44ba001dab6237202ddb0ada/text.txt#:~:text=AI%20resources)). Reject this roundup on relevance and evidentiary depth; assessing those underlying reports would require their original evidence. The paid-content promotion establishes the publisher's subscription interest, not independent validation or proof of vendor sponsorship ([saved promotion](data/assets/4eab969d8f8f58425aecc153/7e321e65424e9a2edb24b698e1bca81a81aaeadd44ba001dab6237202ddb0ada/text.txt#:~:text=All%20my%20paid%20goodies)).

Accept as a qualified research case study. Supplied publication metadata places the September 16 preprint inside the 30-day UTC window ending October 13; the experiment itself ran April 26–May 8, so the new development is its reported evidence, not a newly conducted run ([saved §4.3](data/assets/59b2cb8b434efeeb70a133bc/66025228eaffdbf60602a9c3e085782385578f7304cce9751aff2a52b9936729/text.txt#:~:text=4.3%20Research%20loop)). The authors report Git-linked experiments and negative results, with development performance improving from 3.3923 to 1.899044 bpb. Every component was selected on the same 200-text evaluator; the trained GPT-2 reference is not a matched coordination baseline, and the smallest gains fall below hardware variation ([saved §4.5](data/assets/59b2cb8b434efeeb70a133bc/66025228eaffdbf60602a9c3e085782385578f7304cce9751aff2a52b9936729/text.txt#:~:text=4.5%20Evidence)). Different-account verifications are internal checks, not independent external replication; one 'confirmed' discrepancy exceeded the stated approximate tolerance. The autonomy claim also needs qualification: humans changed prompts and search views together, and a manually launched session contributed to the winning ancestry ([saved §4.7](data/assets/59b2cb8b434efeeb70a133bc/66025228eaffdbf60602a9c3e085782385578f7304cce9751aff2a52b9936729/text.txt#:~:text=4.7%20Human%20intervention)). The authors did not rerun the winner and report missing evaluator logs and dependency/data pins ([saved §4.8](data/assets/59b2cb8b434efeeb70a133bc/66025228eaffdbf60602a9c3e085782385578f7304cce9751aff2a52b9936729/text.txt#:~:text=4.8%20How%20we%20verified)). Thirteen workers each had an 80-GB GPU, but the report supplies no complete monetary budget; student affordability and discovery efficiency are unestablished ([saved §4.2](data/assets/59b2cb8b434efeeb70a133bc/66025228eaffdbf60602a9c3e085782385578f7304cce9751aff2a52b9936729/text.txt#:~:text=4.2%20Agents)). The builders evaluate their own system, an author-interest dependency rather than outside corroboration; no financial conflict is established by the supplied text ([saved experiment framing](data/assets/59b2cb8b434efeeb70a133bc/66025228eaffdbf60602a9c3e085782385578f7304cce9751aff2a52b9936729/text.txt#:~:text=4%20Experiments)). Editorial inference: useful for teaching provenance, negative-result retention and verification requirements, with protected test data and matched-budget comparisons needed before claiming general research gains.

Accept for concrete practitioner evidence about costly failures, memory and evaluation design. Supplied September 24 publication metadata falls within the 30-day UTC window ending October 13; novelty is the report of an earlier twelve-week campaign, whose exact calendar dates are not supplied. The paper explicitly frames its contribution as a failure taxonomy and cost-dependent use of standard mechanisms, not a new algorithm ([saved contributions](data/assets/7082835cef4c8540dcb8d480/7d04403761d8cb23614022d48ddb879a6de4fb7f5af821bb1d1d2cb773d97ec4/text.txt#:~:text=Contributions.)). Reported failures include eleven consecutive evaluator timeouts and repeated failed configurations; System A iterations took 9–19 hours on multiple GPUs, versus 6–52 minutes on one GPU for B. Costs are approximate rather than a complete campaign budget ([saved §§II-C–III](data/assets/7082835cef4c8540dcb8d480/7d04403761d8cb23614022d48ddb879a6de4fb7f5af821bb1d1d2cb773d97ec4/text.txt#:~:text=II-C%20Cost%20Profile)). Report the 1.82× Recall@6 gain as a peak offline result: the across-date mean supports 1.63×, and sequential component additions do not isolate causal effects ([saved §V-A](data/assets/7082835cef4c8540dcb8d480/7d04403761d8cb23614022d48ddb879a6de4fb7f5af821bb1d1d2cb773d97ec4/text.txt#:~:text=V-A%20System)). Examine, rather than repeat, the contradiction between §V-E's claim that an immutable evaluator prevents metric gaming and §III-E's documented coherence gaming through unusable singleton clusters ([saved validation claim](data/assets/7082835cef4c8540dcb8d480/7d04403761d8cb23614022d48ddb879a6de4fb7f5af821bb1d1d2cb773d97ec4/text.txt#:~:text=V-E%20Validation), [saved failure](data/assets/7082835cef4c8540dcb8d480/7d04403761d8cb23614022d48ddb879a6de4fb7f5af821bb1d1d2cb773d97ec4/text.txt#:~:text=III-E%20Metric%20Fixation)). Likewise, unsuccessful search does not prove the tradeoff mathematically unavoidable. System B used human strategic pivots and human-maintained instructions; these are not training the agent's weights ([saved §IV-D](data/assets/7082835cef4c8540dcb8d480/7d04403761d8cb23614022d48ddb879a6de4fb7f5af821bb1d1d2cb773d97ec4/text.txt#:~:text=IV-D%20Persistence)). Both systems belong to one Amazon book-recommendation setting, giving valuable practitioner experience but a shared organizational interest rather than external corroboration. The authors acknowledge observational ablations, unvalidated customer impact and limited generalization; proprietary purchase data prevent exact public replication, and no independent replication or outside researcher assessment is supplied ([saved limitations](data/assets/7082835cef4c8540dcb8d480/7d04403761d8cb23614022d48ddb879a6de4fb7f5af821bb1d1d2cb773d97ec4/text.txt#:~:text=Limitations.), [saved reproducibility statement](data/assets/7082835cef4c8540dcb8d480/7d04403761d8cb23614022d48ddb879a6de4fb7f5af821bb1d1d2cb773d97ec4/text.txt#:~:text=Reproducibility)). Editorial inference: students can test small loops, retain failure histories and budget human metric review without treating these reported gains as generally established.
